faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIITDM Kancheepuram JRF recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position at IIITDM Kancheepuram is 31st August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the JRF post?
faq.answer: Candidates need to have a B.E./B.Tech. in CSE/IT/ECE with a valid GATE score, or an M.E./M.Tech. in CSE/IT/ECE or relevant streams.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Junior Research Fellow post is 35 years, with age relaxation applicable as per Government of India norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the JRF post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly stipend of Rs. 37,000 plus 30% HRA.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the JRF recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a Written Test followed by an Interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for this job?
faq.answer: Applications for the Junior Research Fellow position must be submitted online.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification and apply online?
faq.answer: You can find the links to the official notification PDF and the online application form in the "Important Links" section of this article.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The position of Junior Research Fellow (JRF) is on a contractual basis.
